Navigation

Breadcrumb

Navigation trail with a non-link current page. Class contract: .rse-breadcrumb.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

Path trail for deep pages — unit detail, program detail, portal sub-pages.

<Breadcrumb items={[{ label: 'Unidades', href: '/unidades' }, { label: 'Sesc São Paulo' }]} />

The last item renders as plain (non-link) text with aria-current="page". Keep to 2-4 levels; this brand's IA is shallow.

Plain HTML contract

<nav class="rse-breadcrumb" aria-label="Trilha de navegação">
  <ol class="rse-breadcrumb__list">
    <li class="rse-breadcrumb__item">
      <a class="rse-breadcrumb__link" href="/unidades">Unidades</a>
      <span class="rse-breadcrumb__separator" aria-hidden="true">/</span>
    </li>
    <li class="rse-breadcrumb__item"><span class="rse-breadcrumb__current" aria-current="page">Detalhes da unidade</span></li>
  </ol>
</nav>

Separators are decorative; keep aria-current="page" on the last item and the navigation label on the root. React forwards the ref and native nav attributes to the nav, and merges className.

Props

PropTypeRequiredNotes
itemsBreadcrumbItem[]—Trail from the home page to the current page; the last item renders as the current page, not a link

Also accepts every attribute of React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, a ref and className.
